UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated atelier or manufacturing staff profile with strictly isolated PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Staff member email address (PII, owner-only read).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update.

InventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
InventoryItem.description: Salwar Kameez garment design record with per-size stock & distinct INR pricing, outsourced Karigar workflow log, raw material specs, and local photography reference.

id.description: Unique design identifier matching the document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning atelier account.

location.description: Workshop rack, shelf, or packing zone in Mumbai unit.

quantity.description: Total finished pieces across all sizes (integer >= 0).

status.description: Design inventory availability or QC status.

sizes.description: Bounded array (1 to 12 entries) of { size: string (1-16), stock: int (0-100000), price: int (0-1000000 INR) }.

lastKarigarName.description: Name of the Karigar the design was most recently given to.

lastKarigarStage.description: Manufacturing craft stage for the latest Karigar handover.

lastKarigarDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the design was last handed over.

karigars.description: Bounded array (0 to 10 entries) of outsourced stage logs { stage, karigarName, unitOrNote, dateGiven }.

rawMaterials.description: Structured raw material specification map { topFabric, colorShade, bottomFabric, dupattaFabric, materialNotes }.

notes.description: General packing, ironing, or dispatch notes.

mediaKey.description: Reference path or local IndexedDB media key (no raw image binaries in Firestore).

photoAspect.description: Applied photo editor crop aspect preset.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when design was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last design update.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated staff user profile containing PII.

/users/{userId}/inventory/{itemId}.description: Owner-scoped Salwar Kameez garment design catalogue entries.
